meta.notes: Squircle display face. Skeletons squared with a superellipse n=4 warp (make_sample --squircle 4), stroke widths x1.80 (--weight 1.8), drawing compressed to y x0.90 so the fattened ink stays inside the design band. Nib is a superellipse n=4 as well (meta.pen), which squares the terminals and fattens the diagonals.
